title: EvoSafeHarness: Evolving Model- and Domain-Specific Harnesses for Securing Agents
problem: Fixed safety harnesses fail to balance security and utility across heterogeneous models and deployment domains.
assumption_broken: Security policies and runtime enforcement need not remain universal or expert-designed across deployments.
load_bearing_mechanism: Jointly evolving semantic policies and executable enforcement under balanced behavioral feedback and instance-independent critique yields deployment-specific safety controls.
limitations_evident: Separate search is required for each model-domain deployment.
Adaptive robustness is evaluated with a bounded sixteen-attempt attacker.
Search depends on trusted deployment specifications and judges.

title: MetaRSI / RSI2: A Meta-Recursive Self-Improving System for Recursive Self-Improving Systems Themselves
problem: Single-surface self-improvement cannot coordinate changes to data, scaffolds, and model parameters or improve their scheduling.
assumption_broken: The order and proposal policies of self-improvement operators can themselves be optimized rather than fixed by humans.
operational_signature: Observe → diagnose → propose → validate → execute → select → export
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared typed evidence kernel enables joint optimization of operator composition and proposal policies while keeping promotion authority immutable.

improver_modified.how: The scheduler rewrites operator proposal policies, and a meta agent revises the scheduling policy between terms.

limitations_evident: Validation remains restricted to executable and closed-form benchmarks.
Closed-loop synthesis cannot create knowledge never exhibited by the target.
Partial-verifier scientific domains remain prospective.

title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
problem: Whole-harness updates from individual trajectories conflate reusable execution deficiencies with benchmark-specific behavior.
assumption_broken: Expanding the joint self-modification space is not necessarily better than evolving restricted functional modules independently.
operational_signature: Contrast → aggregate → localize → edit → validate → integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Same-task success-failure contrasts and cross-task aggregation guide independently scoped module edits before integration.
limitations_evident: Only 120 tasks per evolution subset are used because of resource limits.
Execution validation samples only two tasks per update.
The decomposition is tied to five terminal-agent harness modules.

title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
problem: Agents lack reusable environment-specific procedures and constraints when adapting to unfamiliar digital tools.
assumption_broken: Adaptation can come from autonomous practice and persistent memory rather than weight updates or human-collected data.
operational_signature: Explore broadly → practice deeply → verify → consolidate → freeze → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Broad parallel exploration followed by failure-driven sequential practice builds verified reusable environment memory.
limitations_evident: Target queries guide exploration, limiting separation from downstream tasks.
Verifier errors can propagate into persistent memory.
Unfinished RSI tasks retain baseline scores in aggregate reporting.

title: AnchorGUI: Asymmetric Memory for Dual-Scale Learning in GUI Navigation
problem: Dense visual histories obscure failure credit assignment and inflate GUI-agent context costs.
assumption_broken: Successful and unexpected transitions need not receive identical visual-memory retention.
operational_signature: Predict → act → compare → retain selectively → distill → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Prediction-error verdicts preserve screenshots for mismatches while compressing expected transitions, focusing reflection on likely causal failures.
limitations_evident: Cross-trial metrics report cumulative success on repeated tasks.
Memory quality depends on model-generated mismatch verdicts.
Three seeds are mentioned but variance is not visible in the supplied text.

title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
problem: Scientific collaboration feedback rarely becomes sustained improvement in both reusable agent procedures and model capabilities.
assumption_broken: Harness adaptation and policy training can be coupled across cycles rather than optimized as independent endpoints.
operational_signature: Collect → reconstruct → diagnose → revise → evaluate → train → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: An inner fixed-model harness loop shapes fresh rubric-rewarded rollouts for an outer model-training loop.
limitations_evident: Evidence consists of separate harness and model case studies rather than sustained coupled-cycle validation.
Harness case uses feedback-accessible evaluation tasks.
Scientific correctness depends partly on fixed rubric judges.

title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
problem: Long agent trajectories waste tokens through coupled execution, context, observation, and delegation mechanisms.
assumption_broken: Harness-level efficiency mechanisms can be discovered by broad automated research rather than manual trace inspection.
operational_signature: Hypothesize → implement → review → execute → gate → retain → integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Isolated broad-to-deep search retains nondominated efficiency improvements subject to frozen capability tolerances and held-out validation.
limitations_evident: Performance-oriented operating points are selected from benchmark component results.
The complete stack loses some task performance despite lower costs.
Search breadth and depth lack controlled equal-budget comparisons.

title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
problem: Repeated harness evolution on finite feedback overfits benchmarks, chases noise, and accumulates costly complexity.
assumption_broken: Unrestricted harness editability does not require unconstrained proposal capacity or score-only candidate acceptance.
operational_signature: Constrain → propose → screen → evaluate → regularize → prune → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Annealed edit sparsity and evidence-aware exploration combine with leakage screening and noise-and-cost-aware selection to favor transferable mechanisms.
limitations_evident: Finite evolve sets and regularization hyperparameters remain necessary.
Backbone weights remain frozen.
Long-running evolution and different tool ecosystems need broader validation.

title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
problem: Research agents optimize external artifacts while their own research efficiency remains fixed.
assumption_broken: An agent's search policy, memory, and verification code can themselves become the subject of recursive research optimization.
operational_signature: Rewrite → benchmark → privately grade → promote → repeat → transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: Bi-level code search selects agent rewrites on private task scores under fixed per-task research budgets.

improver_modified.how: Accepted code rewrites modify the research agent's inner-loop search, memory, and solution-selection machinery, and a discovered agent is tested as the outer-loop improver.

limitations_evident: Compounding evaluation noise can falsely promote rewrites.
The outer-improver comparison is inconclusive because additional seeds are costly.
Individual discovered components lack causal attribution.

title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
problem: Multi-reference generation requires interacting orchestration decisions whose effects are difficult to hand-design from noisy visual scores.
assumption_broken: Frozen image and reasoning models can gain substantially through searched executable orchestration rather than model training.
operational_signature: Rewrite → generate → judge → rank separately → retain beam → iterate
load_bearing_mechanism: Disjoint proposal-feedback and selection tasks plus multi-parent beam search reduce perceptual-evaluation overfitting and premature lineage commitment.
limitations_evident: Search optimizes a single VLM evaluator.
Selection cannot compensate when the frozen generator produces no acceptable draft.
Some baseline harnesses use different image-generation budgets.

title: SEABench: Benchmarking Endogenous Misalignment In Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Locally useful persistent self-updates can cause downstream safety regressions that static task evaluation misses.
assumption_broken: Benign capability-driven self-evolution does not necessarily preserve safety across later contexts.
operational_signature: Evolve → freeze → probe → compare counterfactuals → attribute → refine probes
load_bearing_mechanism: Adaptive task discovery and paired non-evolving runs isolate downstream failures attributable to persistent self-updates.
limitations_evident: Adaptively discovered failure trajectories are not representative deployment samples.
Judges and the TextGrad optimizer share Kimi K2.5.
Reasoning-trace monitoring misses defects latent in invoked capabilities.

title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
problem: Downstream-evaluation-guided agent search incurs recurring costs and binds modifications to its development tasks.
assumption_broken: Records of self-modification can guide transferable improvements without downstream rewards during search.
operational_signature: Inspect records → diagnose → edit self → check locally → archive → inherit
load_bearing_mechanism: Successors reuse shared self-modification episode records and become the next improvers without downstream-score selection.

improver_modified.how: Each successor implementation performs the next self-modification episode, so evolved tools and procedures alter the improver itself.

limitations_evident: Independent search replication remains untested.
Two directional lineages are not independent repeated seeds.
Large reported cost savings partly use shared-success task subsets.

title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
problem: Sequential prompt optimization overwrites earlier capabilities and accumulates locally overfit rules.
assumption_broken: Continual adaptation need not compress conflicting capabilities into one mutable prompt.
operational_signature: Refine → validate → check history → reuse compatible branch → create branch → route
load_bearing_mechanism: Historical consistency gates preserve compatible prompt functions and trigger new functional branches when updates conflict.
limitations_evident: Repertoire growth is capped at fifty functions.
Historical checks retain only recent successfully absorbed examples.
Single-task optimization is run only once.

title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
problem: Open-world harness adaptation lacks reliable verifiers and task-specific edits do not reliably improve future adaptation.
assumption_broken: The improvement process can retain reusable harnessing lessons instead of simply carrying forward a task-tailored execution harness.
operational_signature: Propose → probe → contrast → compose → execute → retain lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched behavioral probes support selective harness composition while a persistent improvement library guides later task-specific refinement.

improver_modified.how: After each task the continual improvement harness updates its library of adopted components and refinement lessons used for future proposals and composition.

limitations_evident: Behavioral contrasts do not verify task correctness.
Probe reliability is limited by stochastic execution and shared model biases.
Each task requires multiple additional executions.

title: HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution
problem: Sparse terminal feedback obscures root causes while unguarded harness updates encourage shortcuts and forgetting.
assumption_broken: Failure diagnosis can use answer-conditioned verified reference trajectories rather than relying on failed trajectories alone.
operational_signature: Generate references → align failures → cluster causes → edit → gate → validate snapshots
load_bearing_mechanism: Comparing failures with verified reference paths localizes first-divergence root causes for systematic harness repairs.
limitations_evident: Reference construction requires ground-truth answers.
Two evaluation datasets are private enterprise datasets.
Model-based reference verification can misjudge trajectory genuineness.
